'''Denny Chapin Bouny Hunters vs1 1''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Denny Chapin]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-12463">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/12463 Bouny Hunters vs1 1], DeckTech (Denny "Noj" Chapin, 21 December 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/12463/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/12463/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018082538/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/12463/ Wayback Machine].</ref>
